description:
A failed hangup remains visible alongside a failed final transcript. The voice call is faked. In an eval, window.liveEmit(event) delivers event from Live (e.g. window.liveEmit({type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Hello ", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 400})); emit each event in its own eval, in the order given. window.liveSpeak(id, speech) speaks and delegates: it emits {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: speech, start_ms: 0, end_ms: 900} and then {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 900, delegation: {id, target: "client"}}. window.liveNotes() returns the JSON of everything Shelley sent to Live. window.__voiceTracksStopped counts the microphone tracks stopped. "Start the call" means: click data-testid "live-call-header"; data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call". "The exchange" is data-testid "live-exchange". "The message X" is the [data-testid="message"] elements whose text contains X (has_text; it collapses whitespace, so a line break is a space). Text checks on messages and the exchange compare whitespace-collapsed text: eval el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").includes(...) with expect true (or false for "not contain"), on every matching element. Once call "intercept" has run, the server answers every relay of events (POST .../live-session/<session>/events) with 503 "Relay failed for test", and every hangup (DELETE .../live-session/<session>) with 503 "Hangup failed for test". Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/hangup and start the call.
2. Call "intercept". Emit {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Already received words", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 1000}.
3. data-testid "live-error" should contain "Failed to relay the call to Shelley", "Could not end the call" and "Hangup failed for test".
